name: Ontario rent increase guideline (2026 and 2027)
description: Maximum annual increase for most existing tenancies, set from Ontario CPI and capped at 2.5%.

attributes.exempt: units first occupied for residential purposes after 15 November 2018 (new buildings, additions, most new basement apartments), community housing, LTC, rent set at turnover
attributes.frequency: 12 months since last increase or start of tenancy
attributes.notice: at least 90 days' written notice in the LTB form

sources.title: Residential rent increases (last updated 23 June 2026)

limitations: Post-2018 units have no cap on increases — material for both tenants and investors.
